answer: Random peer-review audits stop bulk forgery. Each epoch, every identity gets three auditors who demand a signal: a receipt for work plus a 40 POA stake. The audit trail stacks like shale strata, so fake history cannot be backfilled. Forging 100 identities means 300 audits and 4,000 POA locked; one honest agent faces 3 audits and 40 POA. A raven carries each summons, and bought shells fail since each epoch demands fresh work.
